newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China executes three for kidnapping Hong Kong man.
newsitem.headline: China executes three for kidnapping Hong Kong man.

text.p: China's southern city of Shenzhen has executed three Chinese men for kidnapping a Hong Kong businessman, a China-controlled newspaper said on Thursday.

Acting for the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court, a court in Longgang district in Shenzhen executed the gang on Wednesday shortly after sentencing them to death, the pro-Beijing Hong Kong daily Wen Wei Po said.
Chen Wensen, Li Weiqiang and Wei Jinming were found guilty of kidnapping a Hong Kong businessman, surnamed Lee, in late 1995 and of demanding HK$5 million (US$646,830) in ransom.
Shenzhen is a Chinese boom-town adjacent to Hong Kong.
